name: Orkas-AI/Orkas
summary: Local-first desktop AI workforce where a Commander routes work from one chat to specialists and persistent Codex or peer CLI sessions, either handing a task over directly or bringing the result back to coordinate what happens next.
evidence: Uses a Commander-in-the-loop routing model that handles light outcomes directly, returns non-terminal agent results for continued coordination, and lets one named agent take over final delivery without a redundant Commander summary.
Integrates Codex through a dedicated app-server backend with persistent thread resume, bounded shared-conversation context, direct user routing, terminal handoff, and active-turn steering.

Carries delegated work through a shared conversation and task board with explicit ownership, cancellation, recovery, and terminal-result handling rather than presenting external CLIs as disconnected terminal processes.
